text:
Omar (PM): I uploaded a compact-diff prototype — single-line preview + expand, plus an infobar that appears when selecting many rows. PTAL for microcopy, infobar behavior, and a11y. figma: https://figma.com/compact-diff-infobar Zara (Design): the compact line looks clean. question: infobar copy should warn or inform? Options: "Selecting many samples may slow approvals" vs "You have selected 127 samples" + CTA. prefer the second with a soft tone. :speech_balloon: Ken (Eng): implementation note: rendering full diffs on select is expensive. we'll virtualize the list and only hydrate expanded rows. infobar should not trigger re-renders of the whole list; keep it out of the render tree or portal it. Lina (QA): current bug: when infobar appears, it steals focus from the list and keyboard users lose position. expected: infobar is non-modal, doesn't trap focus, and Esc dismisses it if it was user-opened. Also quick-approve shortcut (cmd+shift+A) must act on selected items without opening the infobar. Eve (Accessibility): a11y asks: infobar must be reachable by keyboard and screen readers, but not an intrusive alert. Use role=\"region\" with aria-labelledby and offer a dismiss button. Announce selection counts via aria-live=\"polite\" rather than changing button labels. For example:
Selected 127 samples
. Omar (PM): microcopy thought: primary action label when multiple rows are selected: "Approve selection". If no rows selected show "Approve changes" disabled with tooltip "Select samples to approve". Also consider inline count in the CTA like "Approve (127)" — but worried about noisy SR updates. Zara (Design): visual idea: keep the CTA stable and render the count in the infobar only. Show a subtle badge on the CTA for visual users, but don't mutate the label text for SR. Also the infobar can offer "Review selection" and "Approve (127)" as two actions. Ken (Eng): agree with keeping button label stable. Changing text often will confuse assistive tech. Instead, update a polite live region for SRs. Implementation snippet: ```
127 samples selected
``` Also debounce updates to that region to avoid spamming SRs while users navigate. Lina (QA): acceptance tests: keyboard-only flow (arrow nav, Space toggles selection, cmd+shift+A quick-approve), infobar appears after >50 selections, Esc hides infobar and returns focus to last row, toast on approve is announced and does not steal focus. Add NVDA/VoiceOver steps. Eve (Accessibility): suggestion: provide an offscreen detailed summary in the infobar for SR users: "127 selected: 12 regressions, 3 critical". Also ensure delta chips next to preview include text like "+4% regressions" not just color. For sparklines provide an sr-only label: "trend: stable with two dips". Omar (PM): decision: v1 keep CTA label stable, show count in infobar only, add infobar threshold at 50, and debounce SR announcements (250ms). Lina/Ken to draft acceptance criteria and PR respectively. Zara (Design): one more visual: when the user selects many (>500) show a gentle confirmation in the infobar: "You're selecting a lot — approve now or review first" with primary "Approve all 512" and secondary "Review selection". Use a progressive disclosure pattern, not a blocking modal. Ken (Eng): backend note: bulk approve will be a batched job — provide immediate optimistic UI and a reversible op id so we can offer Undo for 30s. We'll emit an operation token in the response so the client can call rollback. Sample response: {"op_id":"op_abc123","status":"queued"} — UI should render a non-focus-stealing toast. Lina (QA): test undo flow: approve -> toast shows "Approved 127 samples." with undo link -> clicking undo calls rollback and returns samples to previous state. Ensure focus stays in list after approve; toast link should be reachable via keyboard but not auto-focussed. Eve (Accessibility): ensure toast is role=\"status\" and aria-live=\"polite\". Provide textual breakdown in the toast: "Approved 127 samples: 10 regressions, 2 critical." Avoid emoji-only summaries. Omar (PM): next steps: Ken prototype virtualized list + infobar portal + debounce announcer; Zara update Figma with infobar variants and progressive copy; Lina/Eve write QA + a11y checks. I'll book a 25-min sync tomorrow 10am PT. cc @ux-bot for checklist :white_check_mark: ux-bot: checklist created: [Infobar variants], [Virtualized list PR], [Debounced aria-live], [QA + A11y tests]. Zara (Design): I'll push the updated frames (count badge + infobar threshold + large-selection confirmation) before sync. Ken (Eng): will open a draft PR with canvas fallback for thumbnails, selection announcer debounce, and undo op handling. estimate 3 dev days + 1 QA day. Lina (QA): will add NVDA/VoiceOver scripts and keyboard matrix to the ticket. Eve (Accessibility): will review the acceptance criteria and SR copy, and confirm contrast/pattern fills for delta chips. Omar (PM): thanks everyone — aim to keep v1 focused: compact previews + infobar + stable CTA label. No extra toggles. :tada:
